take: Per the team's announcement, UTA placed forward Kailer Yamamoto on injured reserve. He had 3 goals and 4 assists in 9 games, and UTA controlled 71% of the 5-on-5 chance quality (expected goals share) when he was on the ice. The team was also 16 percentage points better in that measure with him than without. Clayton Keller has taken his spot beside Hayton and Lee, up to 20:09 a night from 18:04, and Jack McBain is up to 13:21 from 11:07.
